text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2.6.0 -> 10% US-WEST. Observability: p95 latency +18%, error rate x2.4 vs baseline. Suggest: hold and re-evaluate in 5m. :warning:
alexa: seeing the same in grafana, errors are 5xx on inference service, also raised tail latency on big prompts.
sam: can someone grab logs for recent model variant? might be kv-cache invalidation.
maria: what threshold do we use for auto-rollback? our policy is 3x error-rate or p95>1s for 3 consecutive mins, right?
kevin: correct. current error spike is 2.4x so not auto yet but it's trending up. I'd prefer manual rollback if it keeps rising.
tasha: I'm on it, starting quick tail log sampling across canary pods. cc @kevin @alexa
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0429. Channel: #incidents. Runbook: Canary regression -> triage -> rollback decision. https://incidents.example/redwood/INC-2026-0429
support-lead: heads-up — I will draft a short internal note for support if we roll back. Please ping me when decision made.
alexa: logs show a NPE in kvcache on host inference-03, stack points at cache migration code landed in 2.6.0. snippet: ```ERROR inference: kvcache.go:214 nil pointer deref```
sam: that's actionable. Can we pin back to 2.5.1 on canary only to stop blast radius?
kevin: yes. Plan A: pause canary traffic routing and revert canary nodes to 2.5.1, Plan B: full rollback if canary still fails after pin. Who can execute manual revert?
tasha: I can run the revert. command plan: ```deployctl rollout set-version --service inference --version 2.5.1 --selector canary=true``` then monitor for 2m.
release-manager: hold — don't drain pods yet. we need a quick smoke test before flipping all canary traffic. Also capture reproducer and PR linked.
alexa: agreed. I'll run smoke tests against pinned 2.5.1 once tasha flips.
oncall-bot: Alert: automated rollback still disabled (policy requires 3x). Manual intervention in progress.
support-lead: draft note done: "We are investigating a canary regression affecting a subset of inference requests in US-WEST. Engineers are reverting the canary. No widespread impact expected." Will post to support channel after rollback confirmation.
kevin: tasha, when you flip, include the commit sha to pin: `sha: b7f3a9c`. Add a pin in release manager to prevent immediate re-deploy.
tasha: executing now, running `deployctl` (taking ~30s)
(30s later)
tasha: done. canary nodes reverted to 2.5.1 (sha b7f3a9c). routing held at 0% for 2.6.0.
alexa: smoke tests: generation sanity + top-k on sample prompts -> OK. Errors dropped to baseline in canary after revert. p95 back to normal.
sam: nice. keep monitoring for 10m then decide next steps (hotfix vs revert full rollout).
kevin: action items: 1) open hotfix PR for kvcache nil guard, 2) schedule rollback communication to customers if we need full rollback, 3) pin deploys for next 2 hours. I'll take PR 1.
release-manager: I'll update the release notes draft: mark 2.6.0 as "paused rollout" and note regression. Also schedule a short postmortem if root cause persists after patch.
support-lead: posting internal note now. external comms on standby.
maria: quick question — do we want to enable automated rollback threshold to 2x temporarily? might help for future regressive releases during this window.
kevin: don't change policy mid-window; we risk toggling protections. We'll rely on manual ops for this release.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0429 updated: status = mitigated (canary reverted). Link: https://incidents.example/redwood/INC-2026-0429
kevin: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: PR link when ready, schedule hotfix deploy once tests pass. closing thread in 30m unless regressions reappear. :thumbsup:
